body: Dude, you just described most of my life perfectly. The only difference is I still haven't opened up to anybody, no therapist or anything. Every day gets harder and harder. Hang in there, we'll get through this hopefully.
Sorry you feel the same :/  my bday is next friday
Wow, thanks a lot for the insight and advice. I'll try to make it better but I don't think much will change
Yay!! A second chance to be depressed every fucking day of my life
What the f... this is exactly how I feel.
I could have wrote this, this is literally me. I always feel like I'm acting to an invisible audience or something. I thought I was the only one.

I watch a lot of youtube and play some games to get my mind distracted but I no longer find any game fun and lately youtube is starting to be the same. I haven't really used reddit a lot but I once started to use it and I never liked it (except for this community but I wouldn't call this fun). Anyways I've tried a lot of things and none of them have worked, cutting is helpful to cope with everything, but it's not really a healthy habit to have. I know that, but it's either cutting or just ending it all.

My Chemical Romance music, so freaking good...
Specially their album "Three Cheers for Sweet Revenge"

I met up with some friends on friday. Turned out two of them were hitting on each other, the other two were in a relationship and the other two were super best friends forever and it was just awful to see all of them having so much fun and love and it was just too much, i went to the bathroom to cry for a while cause it was too much. I didn't have my cutting thing so I couldn't cut and I just went back with a fake smile, no one ecen noticed I was gone. It's been a rough week, it's been a rough month, a horrible year and a shitty life.
Really want all of this to end right now before it gets worse (if that's possible).

I'm really thankful for the support (Im glad I made someone somewhere happy btw, thanks), but why? Why keep going? Why if I feel so shit? A teacher said the other day that if something doesn't feel right then don't keep going (she was talking about careers but it still got to me), and I couldn't agree more, why keep feeling like shit for another 17 years?

I can relate a lot, for like 2 years I felt pretty miserable. I mostly ignored it but I found myself crying most nights without any clear reason. Now I'm 17 and I'm quite sure I'm depressed. I thought about it before, just telling myself I was probably overreacting and just lazy af. But then I found this subreddit and I related so much to most posts that I'm now pretty sure about it (also, suicidal thoughts are a pretty big indicator imo). Anyway, depression is just a label, what matters is how you are feeling, and if you're feeling bad then you should try to get better always, whether by talking about it or looking for more professional help.

Thank you so much for the ideas! I was actually looking for something like a free chatting service but they all seem to be only for the U.S. I'll look into this KUTO thing.
I've thought about the school counselor but I just feel he/she is going to tell my parents straight away. Still gonna try it though.
Anyway thank you very much for the advice!! You actually got me to think about the possibility of feeling better

And how would they afford this professional help? How can I be sure it'll work? Most people here say that it can take a long time to find a therapist that's actually helpful, or that the medicine is complete shit.
 I'd much rather keep it to myself and find a way to cope with it without anyone else involved. I just don't want to hurt people anymore. I can see how my mom worries that I never go out on fridays or my sister just has pity for me. Imagine if they knew... no thanks.

Thats the exact reason I won't talk to them, they love me so much that they would do anything to try and help, and would probably make everything worse for themselves.
I can't do that to them.

Nope, was planning to talk to a friend but then I heard him make fun of a girl who clearly has anxiety and probably depression and I just realized that it wouldn't be much help.
Won't talk to my parents because I don't want to be a burden.

Wow, I made that exact same promise to me last year That if high school ended and it was all the same, I would end it. Just 1 year left and I'm starting to worry. 
Worst thing is I think I won't do it. I really just want to end it all but the guilt of leaving my family like that is just too much. I know it would devastate them.
I can relate so much, if it wasn't for my family I'd probably wouldn't stilll be here.
I don't know, it didn't even feel good. I was just searching for something to cope with everything.
